message.content:
This is an empty steel junction box, which falls under heading 8538 as parts suitable for use solely or principally with switchgear apparatus of headings 8535, 8536, or 8537. Alternatively, boxes for electrical conduit (junction boxes) of steel might go to 8536.90 or 8538.90. Heading 8536 covers boxes only when they are equipped as electrical apparatus, and empty ones are not.

CBP rulings on empty electrical enclosures often classify them under 8538.10 ("Boards, panels, consoles, desks, cabinets and other bases for goods of heading 8537, not equipped with their apparatus"). The EG4-280Ah-AW appears to be an enclosure for a battery rack, and a CBP ruling classified a similar empty box in 8538.10.00. Within 8538.10.00 the statistical suffixes are 8538.10.0000 for the general case, so I'll use that.

Another option is 8538.90.8180 or 8538.90.8160, but the "cabinets... not equipped" wording of 8538.10 fits best.

{"hts_code": "8538.10.0000", "reason": "An empty steel enclosure with knockouts, hinged lockable access panel and wall mounts is a cabinet/base for electrical control apparatus of heading 8537 imported without its apparatus, so it falls in subheading 8538.10."}

predicted_reason: An empty steel enclosure with knockouts, hinged lockable access panel and wall mounts is a cabinet/base for electrical control apparatus of heading 8537 imported without its apparatus, so it falls in subheading 8538.10.
